name: Pilates Hundred
instructions: Lie on your back, knees in tabletop or legs extended at a diagonal, and curl your head and shoulders off the mat.
Reach your arms long by your hips, palms down, a few inches off the mat.
Pump the arms in small, quick beats while you inhale for five counts and exhale for five.
Complete ten breath cycles for a hundred pumps.
cues: Curl the ribs toward the hips and hold
Pump from the shoulder with long arms
Breathe out as if blowing out candles
mistakes: Arching the lower back as the legs lower

name: Pilates Roll-Up
instructions: Lie flat with legs long and arms overhead.
Inhale to lift the arms to the ceiling, then exhale as you nod the chin and peel one vertebra at a time off the mat.
Reach over your legs in a deep scoop, then roll back down slowly, one bone at a time.
cues: Peel up like unzipping the spine
Scoop the belly deep toward the spine
Press the heels long into the floor
mistakes: Throwing the arms to build momentum
Letting the feet pop off the floor

name: Pilates Single Leg Stretch
instructions: Lie on your back, curl the head and shoulders up and draw both knees in.
Extend one leg long at a diagonal while the other knee hugs in, one hand on the shin and one on the knee.
Switch legs in a smooth rhythm, keeping the upper body curled.
cues: Reach the straight leg long and low
Switch legs like a smooth pendulum
mistakes: Dropping the extended leg too low for your back

name: Pilates Double Leg Stretch
instructions: Lie on your back with the head and shoulders curled up and knees hugged in.
Inhale and stretch the arms overhead while the legs extend long at a diagonal.
Exhale and circle the arms wide to hug the knees back in.
cues: Stretch out as far as possible, then pull back in
Keep the lower back heavy on the mat
Circle the arms like a big arc
mistakes: Letting the lower back arch off the mat
Lowering the legs beyond your control

name: Pilates Single Leg Circle
instructions: Lie on your back with one leg extended to the ceiling and the other long on the mat.
Keep the pelvis still and draw a small circle with the raised leg, crossing the body then circling out and around.
Do several circles each way, then switch legs.
cues: Draw a circle about the size of a dinner plate
Press the long leg into the mat
mistakes: Rocking the hips as the leg circles

name: Pilates Rolling Like a Ball
instructions: Sit at the back of your sit bones, hug your shins, and balance with the feet off the mat.
Tuck the chin and round into a tight C-curve.
Inhale to roll back to the shoulder blades, exhale to roll back up to balance.
cues: Stay as round as a ball
Roll back using the abs, not momentum
Keep the distance between heels and hips the same

name: Pilates Spine Stretch Forward
instructions: Sit tall with the legs open slightly wider than the hips, feet flexed, arms reaching forward.
Nod the chin and round forward over a deep scoop of the abs, reaching past the toes.
Stack the spine back up one vertebra at a time to sit tall.
cues: Sit tall as if a string pulls the crown of your head
Scoop the belly as you curl over
mistakes: Collapsing the chest forward without the abs
Pulling the shoulders up by the ears

name: Pilates Saw
instructions: Sit tall with the legs wide and the arms stretched out to the sides.
Rotate the torso to one side, then fold forward over the leg, reaching the opposite hand past the little toe.
Return to tall and switch sides.
cues: Keep the hips glued to the mat
Think of sawing off the little toe
mistakes: Rotating the hips off the mat

name: Pilates Swan
instructions: Lie face down with the hands under the shoulders and the legs long.
Press the hands to lift the chest, lengthening through the crown of the head.
Lower slowly with control and repeat.
cues: Lengthen forward and up, not just back
Press the pubic bone into the mat
Keep the shoulders away from the ears
mistakes: Letting the glutes clench and the lower back crunch
Using the arms to push too high

name: Pilates Swimming
instructions: Lie face down, arms long overhead and legs long on the mat.
Lift the arms, chest and legs slightly off the mat.
Flutter opposite arm and leg up and down in a quick rhythm, breathing in for five and out for five.
cues: Reach long through the fingers and toes
Keep the neck long, gaze at the mat
Keep the abs gently lifted off the mat
mistakes: Kicking from the knee instead of the hip

name: Pilates Teaser
instructions: Lie on your back, legs lifted to a diagonal and arms reaching overhead.
Roll up to a V-shape with arms reaching parallel to the legs, balancing on the sit bones.
Roll back down with control, keeping the legs still.
cues: Reach long through the toes and fingers
Keep a tall chest in the V
Roll down like a slow drawbridge
mistakes: Dropping the chest and rounding the back

name: Pilates Scissors
instructions: Lie on your back with the hips rolled slightly up and the legs lifted to the ceiling, hands supporting the hips.
Lower one leg while the other stays up, with a small double-pulse toward the leg.
Switch legs in a scissoring motion.
cues: Keep the hips stacked over the shoulders
Lengthen both legs away from you

name: Pilates Leg Pull Front
instructions: Start in a high plank with the hands under the shoulders.
Lift one leg with the toes pointed, keeping the hips level.
Lower the leg and repeat on the other side, never letting the pelvis shift.
cues: Push the mat away from you
Keep the body in one long line

name: Pilates Spine Twist
instructions: Sit tall with legs together, feet flexed, arms out to the sides.
Inhale to grow tall, then exhale and rotate the torso to one side with two small pulses.
Return to center and rotate the other way.
cues: Turn from the ribs, not the arms

name: Pilates Shoulder Bridge
instructions: Lie on your back with the knees bent, feet flat and hip-width apart.
Peel the spine off the mat one vertebra at a time until the hips are high.
Hold, then roll down slowly from the upper back to the tailbone.
cues: Press the feet down and squeeze the glutes
mistakes: Lifting only with the lower back

name: Pilates Criss-Cross
instructions: Lie on your back, hands behind the head, knees in tabletop and the head and shoulders curled up.
Extend one leg long and rotate the torso to bring the opposite shoulder toward the bent knee.
Switch sides in a steady rhythm.
cues: Rotate from the ribs, shoulder reaches for knee
Extend the leg long and low
mistakes: Yanking the neck with the hands

name: Pilates Side Kick Front and Back
instructions: Lie on your side with the body in one line, head resting on the bottom arm.
Lift the top leg to hip height and swing it forward with two small pulses.
Sweep the leg back past the hip, keeping the torso still, and repeat.
cues: Reach the leg long through the toe
Lift the waist away from the mat

name: Pilates Side-Lying Leg Lift
instructions: Lie on your side, legs together and slightly forward of the hips.
Lift the top leg to hip height, toes slightly turned down.
Lower with control without touching the bottom leg.

name: Pilates Side Kick Clamshell
instructions: Lie on your side with the knees bent and the heels in line with the spine.
Keep the feet together and open the top knee like a clamshell.
Close slowly and repeat.

name: Pilates Inner Thigh Lift
instructions: Lie on your side, top leg bent with the foot or knee on the mat in front of you, bottom leg long.
Lift the bottom leg a few inches off the mat with the toes pointed.
Lower slowly and repeat before switching sides.
cues: Keep the leg long and the hips stacked
Stay in a small, controlled range

name: Fighting Stance
instructions: Stand with the left foot forward in an orthodox stance, feet a little wider than the hips.
Bend the knees slightly and keep the weight on the balls of your feet.
Keep the hands up by your cheeks, elbows in, chin tucked.
cues: Keep the rear heel slightly off the floor

name: Bounce and Shuffle
instructions: Start in your fighting stance.
Bounce lightly on the balls of your feet and shuffle forward, back and side to side without crossing the feet.
Keep the guard up and the head level.
cues: Move like the floor is hot
Push off the back foot to go forward

name: Jab
instructions: From your stance, extend the lead hand straight at the target as you rotate the lead shoulder in.
Snap the fist in at the end so the palm faces down.
Retrace the same straight line back to your guard.
cues: Snap it out and snap it back
Rotate the fist at the end
Keep the rear hand glued to your chin

name: Cross
instructions: From your stance, pivot the rear foot and rotate the hips and shoulders as the rear hand drives straight forward.
Land with the palm facing down and the rear heel turned out.
Return the hand to your guard and reset the stance.
cues: Throw it from the back foot, up through the hips
Rotate the whole body behind the punch
Chin down, lead hand protects the face
mistakes: Arm punching with no hip turn

name: Lead Hook
instructions: From your stance, pivot the lead foot and turn the hips so the lead arm swings in a tight arc.
Keep the elbow high and the arm bent at about 90 degrees.
Rotate back to your stance and guard.
cues: Turn the hips, the arm follows
Keep the elbow level with the fist
Make the arc small and tight
mistakes: Winding up with a big arm swing

name: Rear Hook
instructions: From your stance, pivot the rear foot and drive the rear hip forward.
Swing the rear arm in a tight horizontal arc at about 90 degrees.
Reset to your guard.
cues: Power comes from the back hip

name: Lead Uppercut
instructions: From your stance, bend the knees slightly and dip the lead shoulder.
Drive up through the legs, rotate the hips and bring the fist upward in a tight arc with the palm facing you.
Return the hand to your guard.
cues: Keep the punch short and tight

name: Rear Uppercut
instructions: From your stance, sink slightly and dip the rear shoulder.
Drive off the back leg and rotate the hips to bring the rear fist upward in a tight arc.
Return to your guard.
mistakes: Dropping the hand far below the chin

name: Jab-Cross (1-2)
instructions: From your stance, throw a straight jab with the lead hand.
Retract the jab and immediately pivot the rear foot as you throw a straight cross.
Return to your guard.
cues: Jab snaps, cross rotates the hips
Keep both hands returning to your chin

name: Jab-Jab-Cross (1-1-2)
instructions: Throw two quick jabs, resetting your guard each time.
Pivot the rear foot and throw a straight cross.
Return to your guard.
cues: Short double jab, then power on the cross

name: Jab-Cross-Hook (1-2-3)
instructions: Throw a jab and a cross in a smooth 1-2.
Pivot the lead foot and rotate your hips to throw a lead hook.
Reset into your stance.
cues: Flow the hips from cross into hook

name: Jab-Cross-Slip-Cross
instructions: Throw a jab and a cross.
Slip your head to the outside of an imagined return punch by bending the knees and dipping the shoulders.
Come up and throw a cross.
cues: Bend the knees to slip, do not lean

name: Front Kick (Teep) Lead
instructions: From your stance, lift the lead knee toward your chest.
Extend the leg and push the ball of the foot into the target, hips pressing forward.
Snap the leg back and return to your stance.
cues: Think of pushing the target away

name: Front Kick (Teep) Rear
instructions: From your stance, drive the rear knee up toward your chest.
Push the hips forward and extend the leg into the target.
Retract the leg and return to your stance.
cues: Stay balanced on the standing leg
mistakes: Flopping the kicking leg back down

name: Lead Roundhouse Kick
instructions: From your stance, pivot the supporting foot so the heel points to the target.
Swing the lead leg in an arc and turn the hip over, striking with the shin.
Rechamber the leg and return to your stance.
cues: Pivot the foot and turn the hip over
Strike with the shin, not the foot

name: Rear Roundhouse Kick
instructions: From your stance, pivot the lead foot and rotate the hips as the rear leg swings up in an arc.
Strike with the shin and rotate fully through the hips.
Bring the leg back and return to your stance.
cues: Pivot the front foot, whip the hip

name: Side Kick
instructions: Turn your body sideways and lift the rear knee toward your chest.
Extend the leg out to the side, striking with the heel or the outside edge of the foot.
Retract the leg and return to your stance.
cues: Chamber the knee, then push out the heel

name: Rear Knee Strike
instructions: From your stance, step in as you pull your hands down on an imagined head.
Drive the rear knee up and forward, hips thrusting through.
Lower the knee and return to your stance.
cues: Pull the target down to meet it

name: Lead Knee Strike
instructions: From your stance, lift the lead knee and drive it forward.
Press the hips through and keep the torso upright.
Return to your stance.
cues: Stay on the ball of the support foot

name: Bob and Weave
instructions: From your stance, bend the knees and dip under an imagined punch.
Move the head in a U-shape from one side to the other.
Come back up into your stance.
cues: Bend the knees and keep the back straight
mistakes: Standing up in a straight line

name: Jab-Cross-Rear Roundhouse
instructions: Throw a jab and a cross.
Pivot the lead foot and drive a rear roundhouse kick through the target.
Return to your stance.

name: Teep and Cross
instructions: Throw a lead teep to push the opponent back.
Land the foot forward and immediately fire a cross.
Reset into your stance.

name: Jumping Jacks
instructions: Stand tall with feet together and arms at your sides.
Jump the feet apart while swinging the arms overhead.
Jump back to the start and repeat at a steady pace.
cues: Land softly on the balls of the feet

name: High Knees
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Run in place, driving each knee to hip height.
Pump the arms in rhythm.
cues: Drive knees up to hip height
Stay on the balls of your feet

name: Butt Kicks
instructions: Stand tall and jog in place.
Kick each heel up toward your glute.
Keep the torso upright and arms swinging.
cues: Flick the heel toward the glute

name: Run in Place
instructions: Stand tall with arms bent at your sides.
Jog in place, lifting the feet a few inches.
Swing the arms in rhythm and breathe steadily.

name: Burpees
instructions: Stand tall, then squat and place your hands on the floor.
Jump or step the feet back to a plank and lower the chest to the floor.
Press up, jump the feet in, then jump up with the arms overhead.
cues: Keep the abs braced in the plank
mistakes: Sagging the hips in the plank

name: Jump Squats
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down until the thighs are near parallel.
Explode upward, then land softly and go straight into the next rep.

name: Jump Rope
instructions: Hold the rope handles at hip height with the elbows close to your sides.
Swing the rope from the wrists and hop over it with small jumps.
Stay on the balls of your feet.
cues: Turn the rope with the wrists
Small hops, a quarter inch off the floor
mistakes: Swinging the rope with the whole arm

name: Skater Hops
instructions: Stand on one leg and leap sideways to the other, landing softly.
Sweep the free leg behind the standing leg.
Keep the hips low and push off into the next hop.
cues: Push off sideways and land softly

name: Squat Jacks
instructions: Start with feet together in a small squat, hands at your chest.
Jump the feet wide into a squat.
Jump the feet back together.

name: Lateral Shuffle
instructions: Stand in a half squat with feet shoulder-width apart.
Shuffle sideways several steps without crossing the feet.
Shuffle back the other way.

name: Treadmill Walk
instructions: Stand on the side rails and start the belt at a slow speed.
Step on and walk at a brisk pace with a tall posture.
Swing the arms naturally and avoid gripping the rails.

name: Treadmill Incline Walk
instructions: Set the incline to 5 to 12 percent and a comfortable speed.
Walk with a slight forward lean from the ankles.
Let the arms swing and keep the hands off the rails.
cues: Push the belt back with each step
Lean from the ankles, not the waist

name: Treadmill Run
instructions: Warm up with a walk, then raise the speed to a comfortable run.
Land with the foot under your hips and keep the stride quick.
Cool down with a walk.
mistakes: Running too close to the front

name: Treadmill Sprint Intervals
instructions: Warm up for five minutes at an easy pace.
Sprint for 20 to 30 seconds, then walk or jog for 60 seconds.
Repeat for several rounds and cool down.
cues: Step on the rails to rest, never jump off

name: Stationary Bike
instructions: Adjust the seat so the knee is slightly bent at the bottom of the pedal stroke.
Pedal at a steady cadence.
Increase the resistance as needed.

name: Recumbent Bike
instructions: Adjust the seat so the legs reach the pedals with a slight knee bend.
Sit back against the backrest and pedal smoothly.
Adjust the resistance for your goal.
cues: Push the pedals through a smooth circle
Keep the knees in line with the toes
mistakes: Seat too far or too close

name: Elliptical Trainer
instructions: Step on and hold the moving handles.
Push and pull with the arms while your legs move in an oval stride.
Keep the torso tall.

name: Rowing Machine
instructions: Sit with the feet strapped in and grip the handle with arms straight.
Drive with the legs first, then lean back slightly and pull the handle to the lower ribs.
Reverse the sequence: arms, torso, then legs, and slide forward.
cues: Legs, back, arms on the drive

name: Stair Climber
instructions: Step onto the machine and start at a slow pace.
Climb with a tall posture, using the full foot on each step.
Rest your hands lightly on the rails.
mistakes: Short shallow steps on the toes

name: Assisted Pull-Up Machine
instructions: Select an assistance weight and kneel or stand on the pad.
Grip the handles and pull the chest toward the bar.
Lower with control to a full hang.
cues: Pull the elbows down to your pockets

name: Assisted Dip Machine
instructions: Select the assistance weight and kneel on the pad.
Grip the handles and lower the body until the elbows reach 90 degrees.
Press up to straighten the arms.
cues: Lean slightly forward for the chest

name: Back Extension Bench
instructions: Set the pad below the hips and anchor your heels.
Cross your arms and lower the torso from the hips with a flat back.
Lift until the body is in a straight line.
cues: Hinge at the hips, flat back

name: Seated Row Machine
instructions: Adjust the seat so the chest is against the pad.
Pull the handles back, squeezing the shoulder blades together.
Return slowly.

name: Chest Press Machine
instructions: Adjust the seat so the handles line up with the mid-chest.
Press the handles forward until the arms are almost straight.
Return slowly.

name: Pec Deck Machine
instructions: Set the seat so the handles are at chest height.
Bring the handles together in front of you.
Open slowly until you feel a stretch.

name: Shoulder Press Machine
instructions: Adjust the seat so the handles are at shoulder height.
Press up until the arms are almost straight.
Lower under control.

name: Lat Pulldown
instructions: Adjust the thigh pad and grab the bar slightly wider than shoulder width.
Pull the bar to the upper chest by driving the elbows down.
Return slowly to full stretch.

name: Cable Biceps Curl
instructions: Attach a straight bar to the low pulley and stand facing the stack.
Curl the bar to the shoulders with the elbows pinned.
Lower slowly.

name: Cable Woodchop
instructions: Set the pulley high and stand sideways with the handle in both hands.
Rotate and pull the handle diagonally across the body to the opposite hip.
Return slowly.
cues: Rotate through the torso, arms long

name: Wall Sit
instructions: Stand with your back against a wall and feet shoulder-width apart.
Slide down until the thighs are parallel to the floor.
Hold, keeping the back flat against the wall.
cues: Press your back into the wall

name: Bulgarian Split Squat (Bodyweight)
instructions: Stand a stride in front of a bench and place the rear foot on it.
Lower the back knee toward the floor.
Drive through the front foot to rise.

name: Dumbbell Bulgarian Split Squat
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and set the rear foot on a bench.
Lower the back knee toward the floor.
Drive through the front foot to rise.

name: Dumbbell Farmer's Walk
instructions: Pick up a heavy dumbbell in each hand and stand tall.
Walk with short controlled steps.
Keep the shoulders down and back.

name: Goblet Squat
instructions: Hold a dumbbell vertically against your chest.
Sit down between your hips, elbows inside the knees.
Push through the floor to stand.

name: Dumbbell Hip Thrust
instructions: Sit with your upper back against a bench and a dumbbell resting on your hips.
Drive through the heels to lift the hips until the body is in a line.
Lower with control.
cues: Squeeze the glutes at the top

name: Dumbbell Woodchop
instructions: Hold one dumbbell with both hands near one hip.
Rotate and lift the dumbbell diagonally across the body overhead.
Reverse with control.

name: Bird Dog
instructions: Start on hands and knees, hands under the shoulders and knees under the hips.
Extend the opposite arm and leg until they are in line with the torso.
Return and switch sides.
cues: Reach long through fingers and toes

name: Superman
instructions: Lie face down with the arms reaching overhead.
Lift the arms, chest and legs slightly off the mat.
Hold briefly and lower.

name: Clamshell
instructions: Lie on your side with knees bent and feet stacked.
Keep the feet together and open the top knee.
Close slowly.

name: Side-Lying Leg Raise
instructions: Lie on your side, legs straight and stacked.
Lift the top leg to about 45 degrees.
Lower slowly.

name: Fire Hydrant
instructions: Start on hands and knees.
Lift one knee out to the side, keeping the knee bent.
Lower and repeat.
cues: Open the hip, keep the knee bent

name: Donkey Kick
instructions: Start on hands and knees.
Kick one heel toward the ceiling with the knee bent.
Lower with control.
cues: Push the heel to the ceiling

name: Knee Push-Up
instructions: Start on your hands and knees with the body in a line from the head to the knees.
Lower the chest toward the floor.
Press back up.
cues: Straight line from head to knees

name: Glute Bridge
instructions: Lie on your back with the knees bent and feet flat.
Drive the hips up until the body is in a line.
Lower with control.
cues: Push the floor away through the heels
Squeeze the glutes at the top

name: Bodyweight Calf Raise
instructions: Stand on the edge of a step with the heels hanging off.
Rise onto the balls of the feet.
Lower below the step for a stretch.
cues: Rise as tall as you can

name: Reverse Lunge
instructions: Stand tall with feet together.
Step back and lower the back knee toward the floor.
Push through the front heel to return.
